user.title: Connect to SSL Reverse Proxy
user.description: Issue a key in SSL Reverse Proxy under API keys with the Home Assistant preset. Read only also works, without the Reload and Renew buttons.

data_description.url: The control plane's address, for example https://proxy.example.com.
data_description.api_key: Needs at least ServerRead and CertRead.
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only for a self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the API key
reauth_confirm.description: The key for {url} was refused. Issue a new key in SSL Reverse Proxy under API keys and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SSL Reverse Proxy
reconfigure.description: Leave the key blank to keep the current one.
